description.value: Edo Japan Summit Centre is a franchise location of a proudly Canadian fast food chain founded in 1979, serving Japanese teppan-grilled food including bento boxes, teriyaki bowls, hand-rolled sushi made in-store daily, gyoza, and miso soup. Located inside the Summit Centre mall in Kamloops, it offers dine-in seating alongside takeout and delivery. A loyalty rewards app (Teriyaki Insider Levels) lets regulars earn coins on purchases.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content for the Summit Centre location is fully available and confirms the restaurant's address (#5C, 1200 Summit Dr), phone number (778-471-9318 matching OSM), and service modes (dine-in, take-out, delivery). OSM tags confirm takeaway=yes and delivery=yes, both corroborated by the website. No mention of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or cyclist-specific amenities appears on the website or in OSM tags, so those fields remain null. OSM opening hours for Wednesday differ from the website (OSM: 11:00–18:00; website: 10:30am–9pm), flagged as a concern.
concerns: OSM opening hours for Wednesday (11:00–18:00) conflict with website hours (10:30am–9pm). Website should be treated as authoritative.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible fast food restaurant confirmed by website. A practical stop for touring cyclists seeking a hot meal or takeout in Kamloops.
